rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who turns against their own side, especially in a conflict or political struggle.

example.english: They gave military intelligence to the enemy country; they are a traitor.
example.traditional: 佢為咗敵國提供軍情，根本係叛徒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 zo2 dik6 gwok3 tai4 gung1 gwan1 cing4 gan1 bun2 hai6 bun6 tou4

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone who betrays or aids the enemy against their own country; it is more pointed than 叛徒.

example.english: Everyone called them a traitor because they helped the enemy against their own country.
example.traditional: 大家都鬧佢係賣國賊，因為佢幫敵人對付自己國家。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 naau6 keoi5 hai6 maai6 gwok3 caak6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 bong1 dik6 jan4 deoi3 fu6 zi6 gei2 gwok3 gaa1

rows.note: Use this noun phrase when someone betrays another person's trust or confidence, with A identifying the person betrayed.

example.english: I will never trust him again; he is a traitor who betrayed Ming.
example.traditional: 我唔會再信佢，佢係出賣阿明嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 wui5 zoi3 seon3 keoi5 keoi5 hai6 ceot1 maai6 aa3 ming4 ge3 jan4
